name: duopore-public-client-handover-checklist
description: Find gaps in a client handover before you mark the work ready.

interface.longDescription: Find gaps in a client handover before you mark the work ready. List the required items, their owners, whether they are done, and any proof references. See missing items and unclear ownership in one checklist. Optional unfinished items stay visible. The app uses your updates; it does not open proof links or approve the handover.
defaultPrompt: Check what is missing from this client handover.
Which required handover items still need an owner or proof?
